import io
import pytest
from rich.style import Style
from rich.text import Text
from rich.console import Console
from rich.measure import Measurement


def test_from_ansi_trailing_newline():
    """
    Test that Text.from_ansi() does not remove a trailing newline.
    """
    # Test case 1: Single newline character
    text_with_newline = Text.from_ansi("\n")
    expected_text_with_newline = Text("\n")
    assert text_with_newline == expected_text_with_newline, (
        f"Expected Text('{expected_text_with_newline.plain}') "
        f"but got Text('{text_with_newline.plain}') for input '\\n'"
    )

    # Test case 2: Text ending with a single newline
    text_ending_with_newline = Text.from_ansi("hello\n")
    expected_text_ending_with_newline = Text("hello\n")
    assert text_ending_with_newline == expected_text_ending_with_newline, (
        f"Expected Text('{expected_text_ending_with_newline.plain}') "
        f"but got Text('{text_ending_with_newline.plain}') for input 'hello\\n'"
    )

    # Test case 3: Text ending with multiple newlines
    text_ending_with_multiple_newlines = Text.from_ansi("world\n\n")
    expected_text_ending_with_multiple_newlines = Text("world\n\n")
    assert text_ending_with_multiple_newlines == expected_text_ending_with_multiple_newlines, (
        f"Expected Text('{expected_text_ending_with_multiple_newlines.plain}') "
        f"but got Text('{text_ending_with_multiple_newlines.plain}') for input 'world\\n\\n'"
    )

    # Test case 4: Text without a trailing newline (should remain unchanged)
    text_no_newline = Text.from_ansi("plain text")
    expected_text_no_newline = Text("plain text")
    assert text_no_newline == expected_text_no_newline, (
        f"Expected Text('{expected_text_no_newline.plain}') "
        f"but got Text('{text_no_newline.plain}') for input 'plain text'"
    )

    # Test case 5: Empty string
    empty_text = Text.from_ansi("")
    expected_empty_text = Text("")
    assert empty_text == expected_empty_text, (
        f"Expected Text('{expected_empty_text.plain}') "
        f"but got Text('{empty_text.plain}') for input ''"
    )
